gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-athiti: Bushcraft spaces its letters extra wide and never shifts weight along a curve, so capitals barely stand out. And it earns its keep large and brief, while Athiti lets a see-through s do the quiet work.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-atkinson-hyperle: Atkinson Hyperlegible reads crisp, with clipped capitals beside its lowercase. What stands out most is the gap between Bushcraft's closed, stem-heavy bowls and a body whose letters stay open and light.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono looks plain and open, with counters that breathe and spacing stretched like stencil bridges. But Bushcraft is the one with attitude, closed and uniform in weight, while the mono just keeps the text moving.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Next has lowercase eyes big as washers and rounds left unlatched. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next handles the steady reading, while Bushcraft, wide-spaced with no thick-thin flicker, takes the showy work.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-biryani: Biryani reads clear and open, with large eyes on every e and small counters that never clog. Paragraph after paragraph would glide, with Bushcraft's wide display letters on top.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-blinker: Blinker holds its line thickness and lets the lowercase fill most of the height. Under Bushcraft's closed, widely spaced letters, that open-aperture text gives the eye somewhere easy to land on.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic reads modern, with a high x-height and generous c openings. Bushcraft is better at announcing, its closed, wide-spaced letters cut with one fixed nib width, while Carrois Gothic is better at the sentences after.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-carrois-gothic-s: Wide-set and unshaded up top, open below: Bushcraft sprawls while Carrois Gothic SC keeps capitals and lowercase nearly level. Closed letters over open ones is the real difference here.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-chivo: Bushcraft draws a tube-like, constant-width stroke with closed letters spaced far apart. Chivo packs lowercase up toward the caps and leaves daylight in every curve, so it handles the reading while Bushcraft does the showing.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-chocolate-classi: Chocolate Classical Sans reads large and open, a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut. And paragraphs would move easily beneath Bushcraft, whose closed, widely spaced letters stay put as the display voice.
